## Rules for every Race

### Resources

Ore (blue crystal), Plasma (orange) and Data Fragments (green) come from fixed nodes on the map, gathered by harvesters inside your territory. Energy comes from Reactors and the Core; below 100%, production, sensors and defenses get worse.

### Core Eras

- **Era I — Foundation**: Reactor, Refinery, Barracks, Tower, Outpost and walls. Basic infantry and Pirates.
- **Era II — Expansion** (300 Ore + 80 Plasma, 25 s): Unlocks the Factory, Hangar and Laboratory, the midgame units, the Reactors' Fusion Chamber and the Barracks Academy.
- **Era III — Dominion** (400 Ore + 320 Plasma + 60 Data, 40 s): Unlocks the heavy units, the superweapon, Weaponry and Armor, the Towers' Heavy Battery and your Race's Ascension.

### Laboratory research

- **Weaponry** (Era III, 150 Data): +15% damage for all units and towers.
- **Armor** (Era III, 150 Data): −13% damage taken by units and structures.
- **Sensors** (Era II, 100 Data): +25% sensor range.

### Modules with a choice

From Era II on, each of these buildings takes one module, chosen from two (150 Ore + 50 Plasma, 15 s to install). The choice is permanent.

| Building | Option A | Option B |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Refinery | **Ore Press** — +0.5 Ore per second. | **Armored Vault** — +60% health and regenerates 4 health/s. |
| Vehicle Factory | **Fast Line** — 20% faster production in this Factory. | **Reinforced Chassis** — Vehicles from here come out with +15% health. |
| Drone Hangar | **Afterburner** — Drones from here come out 12% faster. | **Repair Dock** — Repairs your flying units within 160 (5 health/s). |
| Laboratory | **Data Antenna** — +0.3 Data per second. | **Counterintelligence** — Detects cloaked enemy units within 260, like a Tower. |
| Forward Outpost | **Forward Post** — +50% health and regenerates 3 health/s. | **Pulse Mine** — A 45-damage area pulse on enemies within 90, every 6 s. |
